changeSet.author: nfnn
changeSet.sql: update admin_action a set details = 'Nastavení měsíčního přehledu změněno: počet příjemců ' || cardinality(string_to_array(m.parts[1], ', ')) || '; ' || m.parts[2] from (select id, regexp_match(details, '^Nastavení měsíčního přehledu změněno: příjemci ([^;]+); (odesílá se .+)$') as parts from admin_action where action = 'CHANGE_REPORT_SETTINGS') m where a.id = m.id and m.parts is not null

update admin_action a set details = 'Monthly report settings changed: ' || cardinality(string_to_array(m.parts[1], ', ')) || ' recipient(s); ' || m.parts[2] from (select id, regexp_match(details, '^Monthly report settings changed: recipients ([^;]+); (sent on day .+)$') as parts from admin_action where action = 'CHANGE_REPORT_SETTINGS') m where a.id = m.id and m.parts is not null

update admin_action a set details = 'Měsíční přehled za ' || m.parts[1] || ' ručně odeslán, počet příjemců ' || cardinality(string_to_array(m.parts[2], ', ')) from (select id, regexp_match(details, '^Měsíční přehled za (\d{4}-\d{2}) ručně odeslán na (.+)$') as parts from admin_action where action = 'SEND_MONTHLY_REPORT') m where a.id = m.id and m.parts is not null

update admin_action a set details = 'Monthly report for ' || m.parts[1] || ' sent by hand to ' || cardinality(string_to_array(m.parts[2], ', ')) || ' recipient(s)' from (select id, regexp_match(details, '^Monthly report for (\d{4}-\d{2}) sent by hand to (.+@.+)$') as parts from admin_action where action = 'SEND_MONTHLY_REPORT') m where a.id = m.id and m.parts is not null
